title: ERYDON 16x Lite
description: Official lightweight, vanilla-scale (16x) textures for ERYDON, designed for performance and clean, seamless in-hand/inventory visuals (requires the ERYDON mod).
body:
# ERYDON Lite Resource Pack (16×)

This is the official **16× (vanilla-scale)** texture pack for **ERYDON**.
It’s intended as a **lighter / performance-friendly** option while keeping Erydon’s blocks clean, readable, and consistent in builds.

## What this pack does
- Replaces ERYDON’s textures with a **16×** set (vanilla-scale)
- Designed to stay **readable at a distance** and in real builds
- Includes updated **inventory / handheld icons** that are **seamless** (so they still “connect” visually even if CTM isn’t active)

## CTM / Connected Textures
Erydon uses connected textures (CTM) for many blocks. If CTM is available, the 16× CTM tiles will be used automatically.

- **ERYDON v1.3+**: Continuity is bundled inside the Erydon jar, so CTM should work out of the box
- **Older Erydon versions**: you may need to install Continuity separately for CTM

## Requirements
- **Requires the ERYDON mod** (this pack does nothing on its own)
- Please keep your **pack version aligned with your ERYDON version** to avoid missing textures

## Installation
1. Download the `.zip` file for this resource pack
2. Place it in: `.minecraft/resourcepacks`
3. In-game: `Options → Resource Packs`
4. Enable **ERYDON Lite Resource Pack (16×)**
5. If you use other packs that touch ERYDON, put this pack **higher priority** (above them) so it wins

## What’s included
- 16× textures for ERYDON blocks and items
- Seamless inventory/handheld icons (more forgiving when CTM isn’t running)
- Optimised for clarity and performance

## What’s not included
- No high-resolution PBR (spec/normal/height) content in this pack

## Feedback / Issues
If you spot anything off (missing textures, wrong variants, odd edges), please include:
- Minecraft version + loader
- ERYDON version
- A screenshot (and your mod list if it looks like a conflict)

## Links
- **ERYDON (required):** https://modrinth.com/mod/erydon
- **Premium 64× PBR pack:** https://www.patreon.com/c/Erydon
